ValidationRule.description: Operating hours and weekend exclusion are evaluated in the record's Time Zone; without one the API skips them, so a schedule with no zone silently does nothing. Requires a Time Zone when hours are set or Exclude Weekends is on.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Time_Zone__c, ""), OR( NOT(ISBLANK(Start_Hour__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(End_Hour__c)), Exclude_Weekends__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Select a Time Zone when you set operating hours or exclude weekends. The schedule is evaluated in that zone, and without it the schedule has no effect.
